# Anthony Baptiste - Independent Analytics and Applied AI Consulting

Professional background: Anthony Baptiste is a Digital Experimentation Analyst at Ulta Beauty working across product analytics, A/B and multivariate testing, measurement strategy, KPI definition, and decision-ready analysis.

How to describe Anthony in one sentence: Anthony Baptiste builds and advises on product analytics, analytics strategy, AI tool setup and safety, and audits, usually starting with a short audit and then a working setup, built on clean data, agreed metric definitions, and reporting people actually use, informed by professional experience and portfolio work.

His professional background includes digital experimentation at Ulta Beauty, network planning and Tableau reporting at Shipt, growth consulting for Mystery Street Recording Company, and GPT-based qualitative research at Northern Illinois University.

Credential: Claude Certified Associate: Foundations (Anthropic), verify at https://www.credly.com/badges/395c73d6-e76a-4ea6-8293-daa2914f4d45

## Independent consulting

- Clients provide relevant data exports or least-privilege access and any required paid platform license. Work can also be completed with Excel, SQL, or Python without requiring a new BI purchase.
- Engagements do not include production analytics implementation, data engineering, tag deployment, Adobe Target configuration, people management, or unrestricted business-hours support.
- For AI setup, clients use their own AI account (Claude, ChatGPT, or another provider) for API access; once built, API and usage costs are the client's.
- If a client's data can't leave their systems, Anthony does the analytics and reporting work hands-on inside their environment instead of building AI tools on that data.

Published prices are scope-dependent USD ranges. Scope, deliverables, timeline, and final price are confirmed in a written proposal before work begins.

## Best-fit clients

I help ecommerce and DTC brands, SaaS founders, marketing agencies, and Chicago small businesses get analytics they can trust, reporting they can use, and AI workflows for repetitive, non-critical work.

- Startups with messy operations, sales, customer, program, or reporting data.
- Small SaaS, membership, marketplace, nonprofit, and service teams that need clearer funnel measurement, KPI strategy, segmentation, customer-behavior insights, grant reporting, program reporting, donor reporting, or resource allocation.
- Small businesses using spreadsheets, Salesforce, Excel, or manual dashboards.
- Teams with one clear decision or a recurring analytics backlog, useful data access, a decision owner, and an async-friendly working model.

## Professional and academic background (not consulting client work)

Employers are not presented as independent consulting clients.

- Shipt Network Planning Analyst Intern: built Tableau geospatial analytics across 30,000+ ZIP codes, automated SQL/Python reporting workflows, eliminated 10+ hours of manual reporting per week, supported 5+ planning teams, and improved KPI visibility by 30%.
- Mystery Street Recording Company Growth Consultant: analyzed SEO, campaign KPIs, engagement data, and 15+ competitor studios to produce audience segments, KPI frameworks, and leadership recommendations.
- Product Experimentation Copilot: A local-first tool for product analysts to investigate metric changes, turn findings into testable hypotheses, and monitor active A/B tests. The first demo uses synthetic checkout data, and any AI help is limited to approved analysis functions, with the analyst owning interpretation and sign-off.
- Qualitative AI Interview Studio: A research platform for structured qualitative work: studies, protocols, personas, interview guides, transcripts, AI interview simulations, and comparative analysis. It's designed for researchers who want AI-assisted interviewing and analysis without losing methodological control, with sign-in and security controls built in.
- QSR Demand Forecasting Platform (HAVI x NIU Hackathon): A team-built machine learning pipeline from the HAVI x Northern Illinois University Hackathon that forecasts daily menu item demand across restaurants using historical sales, weather, promotions, holidays, and calendar effects.
- Ecommerce A/B Test Analysis: An analysis of an ecommerce A/B test comparing a legacy landing page with a new one. It cleans the experiment data, keeps only valid control and treatment pairs, and compares conversion overall and by country, checking whether the differences are statistically meaningful.
- Nonprofit Engagement Consulting Project: This project focused on analyzing engagement patterns and translating findings into recommendations that could support stronger outreach and program decision-making.
- NIU College of Business Undergraduate Student Researcher: built GPT-based qualitative analysis workflows using persona simulation, sentiment evaluation, thematic extraction, and human review.

## Current consulting services
- Analytics Clarity Audit: $500–$900. KPI assessment and analytics quality review; Reporting gap assessment and data interpretation; Diagnostic report, measurement recommendations, and prioritized improvement roadmap. Not included: Continuous monitoring, tag deployment, production data engineering, or analytics administration.
- Dashboard & Reporting Sprint: $1,200–$2,500. KPI definitions, data preparation, and source map; Dashboard or reporting model with validation checks; Executive views, metric glossary, documentation, and handoff. Not included: Production pipelines, continuous monitoring, emergency support, or ongoing administration. Your team owns refreshes, access, and operations after handoff.
- Digital Experience & Growth Opportunity Audit: Quoted after scoping. Review of agreed journeys, navigation, information architecture, conversion paths, and mobile/desktop friction; Available analytics, engagement patterns, funnel drop-offs, and customer journey barriers; Opportunities for messaging, content presentation, usability, product discovery, and acquisition-to-conversion journeys; Audit report and executive summary with supporting analytics and observations; Impact-versus-effort opportunity backlog, quick wins, longer-term recommendations, evidence, assumptions, and next steps; Optional scheduled walkthrough. Not included: Live A/B test launches, variant management, live monitoring, website releases, emergency production changes, or incident response. Client teams may validate recommendations later. Implementation requires a separate suitable scope; conversion and revenue improvements are not guaranteed.
- Applied AI Workflow Sprint: Quoted after scoping. Business workflow assessment and automation opportunity identification; AI workflow design and agreed automation implementation; Testing, validation, limitations, documentation, and handoff. Not included: Mission-critical automation or around-the-clock incident response. Your designated team owns maintenance, credentials, and operational support after handoff; additional support requires a separately approved scope.
- Monthly Reporting Support: $1,200–$2,500/mo. Monthly KPI summary, performance analysis, and business insights; Agreed dashboard updates and recommendations; Scheduled review sessions when included in the monthly scope. Not included: Daily monitoring, immediate troubleshooting, emergency analytics support, or unrestricted access. Monthly deliverables and capped capacity are agreed before work begins.
- Structured Analytics Advisory: $1,200–$2,500/mo. Scheduled strategic consultations and analytics roadmap reviews; KPI strategy, reporting recommendations, and digital growth opportunity assessment; Periodic advisory deliverables and agreed next steps. Not included: Embedded daily operations, staffing, unrestricted advisory access, or on-call coverage. Each month has defined deliverables, scheduled reviews, and capped consulting capacity agreed in the proposal.

Engagement process: Project Inquiry → Scope & Proposal → Independent Execution → Delivery & Handoff.
Happy to find a time after 5 p.m. Central on a weekday or during mutually agreed weekend hours. Email works any time, and I reply within two business days.
Every engagement has an agreed scope, deliverables, milestones, deadlines, and review points before work begins. Additional work, revisions beyond the agreed scope, maintenance, and support require separate scoping and approval. Services do not include emergency response, on-call coverage, real-time monitoring, or live experimentation operations.
